questions.question: In modern out-of-order processor microarchitectures, what is the primary function of 'store-to-load forwarding' implemented within the Load-Store Queue (LSQ)?
options: Allowing a younger load instruction to retrieve its required data directly from an older, uncommitted store to the same memory address without accessing the cache
Ensuring all store operations commit to the L1 data cache strictly in program order before any subsequent load can issue
Converting atomic read-modify-write memory operations into non-blocking register-to-register moves
Automatically updating page table entries in the TLB whenever a store instruction writes to virtual memory
Reordering independent store instructions ahead of branch instructions to minimize branch misprediction penalties

questions.question: Unlike setup timing violations, why are hold timing violations in synchronous digital circuits considered particularly critical and fatal to an ASIC's post-silicon viability?
options: They cause excessive static leakage current that permanently damages metal interconnects
They cannot be mitigated post-fabrication by simply lowering the operational clock frequency
They can only occur across multiple asynchronous clock domains rather than within a single domain
They degrade the gate oxide layer of transistors via plasma-induced Fowler-Nordheim tunneling
They automatically force synthesis tools to re-execute the floorplanning stage

questions.question: In a cache memory implementing a write-back policy, what is the primary role of associating a 'dirty bit' with each cache block?
options: To identify cache blocks that have parity or ECC errors requiring scrubbing
To denote that a cache line has been invalidated by a snoop hit from another processor core
To track whether the cache block has been modified relative to lower memory levels, indicating it must be written back upon eviction
To track the chronological age of the cache line for the Least Recently Used (LRU) replacement policy
To prevent speculative load instructions from accessing data prior to address translation completion

questions.question: In computer architecture, which term describes a memory storage convention where the least significant byte (LSB) of a multi-byte word is placed at the lowest numeric memory address?
options: Big-endian
Bi-endian
Middle-endian
Little-endian
Sign-extended

questions.question: During the backend-of-line (BEOL) fabrication phase of an integrated circuit, what physical mechanism causes the 'antenna effect' (plasma-induced gate damage)?
options: High electromagnetic interference (EMI) radiation emitted from adjacent wirebonds during packaging
Parasitic inductive cross-coupling between high-speed parallel clock routes operating at microwave frequencies
Mechanical stress fractures produced at standard cell boundaries due to chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP)
Thermal expansion mismatches occurring between low-k dielectric inter-layer materials and copper vias
Accumulation of electrostatic charges on long, unconnected metal interconnects during reactive-ion etching, which discharge through thin transistor gate oxides
